description: This file defines a Flask route for a health check endpoint. It uses Flask-Smorest's Blueprint and Flask's MethodView to implement a simple health status response at the root URL.

classes.name: HealthCheck
classes.description: A Flask view class for the health check route, returning a simple JSON message indicating system health.

methods.name: get(self)
methods.description: Handles GET requests to the health check endpoint, returning a JSON message.

ctags.name: blp
ctags.pattern: /^blp = Blueprint("Healt Check", "health check", url_prefix="\/", description="Health check route"/

fields.name: blp = Blueprint("Healt Check", "health check", url_prefix="\/", description="Health check route"/
